reason: Both sets cover the same myoblast-differentiation, satellite-cell regeneration and striated-muscle adaptation contexts, but A repeats the core myogenesis context across about 16 near-duplicate small themes, while B gives a tighter nested ladder that ends in one broad muscle theme.

A keeps facets the target is about, such as gastrulation/definitive-endoderm and gut-tube patterning (A19/A22), the hepatic alternative fate (A6) and the pancreato-biliary/stomach context (A11), which B mostly lacks; both share the same off-target reproductive and kidney branching themes.

B adds major TCA-cycle contexts that A misses entirely: oxidative phosphorylation and respiratory-chain assembly, the urea cycle, heme biosynthesis from succinyl-CoA, and HIF/2-oxoglutarate oxygen sensing; this outweighs B's larger number of overlapping small themes.

B splits the deamination-repair context into coherent base-excision-repair (uracil processing) and mismatch-repair themes, and adds broader HIV life-cycle and innate antiviral levels, whereas A lumps all DNA repair into one incoherent 91-member theme; B does have more redundant B-cell/SHM variants.

A has the same microglial, amyloid-clearance and synaptic contexts as B, and adds relevant facets B lacks: scavenger-receptor/CD36 uptake with lipoprotein signaling (A37/A39) and a broad NMDA/AMPA glutamatergic synapse theme (A38) matching the excitotoxic arm, despite A having more redundant themes.

A gives a clean ladder from lung mesenchyme through glandular branching morphogenesis to organ and kidney development, while B repeats the same lung/salivary/prostate contexts across about 31 near-duplicate themes and adds only a small FGF/PDGF-regulation facet and an off-target placental theme.
